headword: {栄養教育|えいようきょういく}

definitions.explanation: Teaching people about food, nutrition, and healthy eating habits. Carried out in schools, hospitals, and public-health settings, often by registered dietitians.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{栄養教育|えいようきょういく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: We provide nutrition education at school.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{栄養教育|えいようきょういく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Nutrition education for children is important.

examples.japanese: ⟦{管理|かんり}{栄養士|えいようし}→管理栄養士：29379_kanrieiyoushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{栄養教育|えいようきょういく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}っている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Registered dietitians provide nutrition education to patients at the hospital.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧ (nutrition) + ⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧ (education). A standard term in schools, healthcare, and public health.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {栄養教育|えいようきょういく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive nutrition education
- ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧{栄養教育|えいようきょういく}: school nutrition education

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{食育|しょくいく}→食育：14697_shokuiku⟧: food and dietary education — a broader concept emphasizing attitudes toward food and eating, promoted nationally in Japan
- {栄養指導|えいようしどう}: dietary guidance — individualized advice, often one-on-one with a dietitian
